entities.summary: Novosvobodnaya culture is an archaeological culture of the Early Bronze Age in the foothills of the North Caucasus. It is named after the megalithic tombs excavated in 1898 by Nikolai Veselovsky near the stanitsa Tsarskoy, now Novosvobodnaya in Adygea.
